title: DM Reply Acknowledgements & Cleaner Support Replies
summary: Customer DM replies now receive a CheckMark acknowledgement after successful forwarding, and support replies have a cleaner appearance.
added: A <:CheckMark:1544505870904459264> reaction appears beneath a customer's original DM only after the message is successfully relayed to the support ticket.
changed: Removed the extra **Delta Support** label above the **Delta Support Reply** embed while keeping the reply title, message and footer.
Fixed a relay interruption so customer DMs reach the ticket before the acknowledgement is added.
Ticket-channel messages remain staff-only discussion and do **not** receive automatic checkmark reactions.

history.summary: Ticket command sync and deployment announcement reliability.
